notes.title: Solo Tactics is Joining Steam Next Fest! 🎉
notes.notes:
[h1]⚔️ Solo Tactics is Coming to Steam Next Fest! 🎉[/h1][p]We’re thrilled to announce that [b]Solo Tactics[/b] will be part of the upcoming [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]![/p][p]From [b]October 13th – October 20th, 2025 (PDT)[/b], you’ll be able to:[/p][p]
✅ Play our [b]free demo[/b]
✅ Test out fast-paced [b]1v1 tactical battles[/b]
✅ Swap between 3 champions mid-fight to outthink your opponent
✅ Share your feedback and help shape the future of the game[/p][p]This is a huge milestone for us as a small indie team, and we can’t wait for you to get hands-on with Solo Tactics.[/p][p]👉 Don’t forget to [b]Wishlist & Follow[/b] the game to stay updated:[/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3233940/Solo_Tactics/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thank you all for the amazing support — see you in the arena! 💚[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309890/cbbded172e40ac2a0168f97895cd5b770284b272.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Debut FISTIVAL 2025
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p]🎉 [b]HUGE NEWS![/b] 🎉
We're [i]incredibly proud[/i] to announce that [b]Solo Tactics[/b] has been officially selected for [b]Debut FIST 2025[/b] on Steam! 🥳[/p][p]This is a huge milestone for us — being featured among some of the most promising first-time indie games means the world to our small team. ❤️[/p][p]🕹️ [b]What is Solo Tactics?[/b]
Solo Tactics is a 1 V 1 MOBA where you'll need to rapidly switch between three champions where every decision matters.
Plan, adapt, and dominate — solo.[/p][p]🗓️ [b]Save the date[/b]: Debut FIST runs in 2025 AUGUST 7-11[/p][p][/p][p]📌 Add it to your Wishlist [/p][p]📣 Share the news [/p][p]🎮 And get ready to fight… solo.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309890/edcb32a91f73852b7be4f28d2f0342563d179835.png"][/img][/carousel]

notes.title: Hey, everyone! 👋 Welcome to Solo Tactics
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

this is just a short welcome message 

We'd like to welcome everyone . It's great to have you  Please take a seat, and enjoy the ride with us 

it feels so odd to put our work on steam after 4 years of devolving  ːsteamhappyː 

but we are really happy to finally do it and we would love for you to take this journey with us 

and we still not done there is a lot to do before we finally release the game . For example,  add more champions , more mechanics to add such as flash teleport and the most important feature of them all  cool poses when you win 

We are aiming to actively post developer updates here! So follow us if you're curious about the game, and how it's going.

And before you go, please consider wishlisting our game if you haven't already 


we are a team of 2 brothers working  on this game  
we are glad you considered our game and took the time to read this 

Thank you for coming along for the journey !
